scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:python
scripts.security: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:audit
scripts.lint: node --check server/server.js && node --check scripts/check-no-secrets.js && python3 -m compileall ml_pipeline tests
scripts.smoke: python3 -m ml_pipeline.validate --dataset data/sample/characters && python3 -m ml_pipeline.preprocessing --input data/sample/characters/A/A_1.pgm --output /tmp/roct-preprocessed.pgm --width 8 --height 8
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run client" "npm run server" "npm run ml:server"
